dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder (conversion disorder) presenting as a functional gait disorder, with incongruent falls and no evidence of structural, cerebellar, sensory, or metabolic disease.

ALTERNATIVE 1: MRI-negative posterior circulation ischemia

ALTERNATIVE 2: Factitious disorder or malingering

ALTERNATIVE 3: Intermittent medication- or toxin-induced gait impairment
